title: Ecosystem close-out: DNC 9/32 composition imports the SAME OAI pin (adc7f124) as the 003 family; Mori 0.874957020 is Liu-family; Collet 0.874861 is the tracker-frontier author's earlier step — complete quasi-RH frontier map recorded, nothing adoptable remains
body: Closed the 0138/0139 reading queue for the 2026-10-20 sweep. THREE records examined, all WEAKER than [Z78T] (0.874817065), none adoptable, all recorded for the frontier map. (1) **DNC formalization** (Zenodo 23269134, 2026-10-09; v1.1 abstract: 'Lambda <= 0.2811857 from Liu's improved half-plane'): Lean 4 formalization + verification scripts + audit records for the de Bruijn-Newman bound Lambda <= 9/32 = 0.28125, obtained by composing OpenAI's KERNEL-CHECKED riemannZeta nonvanishing (Re s > 7/8) **from openai/math at commit adc7f124** with de Bruijn's 1950 heat-flow theorem; v1.1 substitutes Liu's 0.8749570697 half-plane for 7/8 and records Lambda <= 0.2811857. PROVENANCE NOTE (load-bearing for the ecosystem): adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a is EXACTLY the Liu OAI pin already recorded in Discovery 0131 (pin-equivalence gate 3) — a third independent Lean consumer (after Liu's own development and the tracker submissions) now imports the same pinned 003 foundation, corroborating its status as the stable composable base of the quasi-RH family. No in-tree adoption (DNC is orthogonal to the strip-front program; no claim is made about Lambda). (2) **Mori** (Zenodo 23355293 preprint + 23355616 'rational certificate and checker', 2026-10-14): zero-free boundary 43747851/50000000 = 0.874957020, 'relative to an explicit list of analytic s...' — Liu-family, LARGER (weaker) than the [Z78L] certified upper 0.874957019420098947 by ~5.8e-10, and far weaker than [Z78T]; provenance-pattern (certificate+checker discipline) only. (3) **Collet, 'A zero-free half-plane with boundary 874861/1000000'** (haileystorm.github.io/research/cycle61-qrh-boundary/): c = 0.125139, boundary 0.874861; 'continues the research behind the single-compensating-prime proof and quartic boundary'; covers all complex Dirichlet characters of nonzero modulus + zeta + the finite-order Eisenstein Hecke family, principal poles excluded, boundary strict. This is the tracker frontier author (the public board's top record description cites 'Collet's affine step') — 0.874861 is an earlier step of the same family that now sits at [Z78T] = 0.874817065 on the board. **COMPLETE FRONTIER MAP (strongest -> weakest, all exact):** [Z78T] 174963413/200000000 = 0.874817065 (adopted; independently replay-verified 0134) < Collet 874861/10^6 = 0.874861 < Xu-Sang B1 8748867/10^7 = 0.8748867 (0137) < Mori 43747851/50000000 = 0.874957020 < Liu (B_inf, certified upper 874957019420098947/10^18; adopted as [Z78L] in 0131) < OAI 7/8 (foundation, B6-closed in 0135). The ranking [Z78T] < [Z78L] < [Z78] is exactly the in-tree implication chain extTrack_implies_extLiu_implies_ext78 (Z78Track.lean / Z78Liu.lean / Z78Strip.lean). **CONCLUSION:** no external record currently beats [Z78T]; the frontier queue is EXHAUSTED for this sweep; the standing posture is unchanged — board watcher (no successor found in the 2026-10-20 checks), internal-flank / new-analytic work toward the residual face hOffT (|Re s - 1/2| <= 74963413/200000000 above tPT2), and broader RH levers. No in-tree change; no RH claim.
